'''Kanako Tōjō''' (Japanese: '''東條加那子''' ''Tōjō Kanako'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Tōjō was born on March 3, 1984, in {{wp|Kagoshima Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actress as an adult. She joined {{aniseries|PTS}} during ''[[Pokémon the Series: XY]]'', first providing the voice of [[Ninja Village]] resident [[Shinobu]]. She then voiced [[Cherie]], one of [[Alva]]'s villainous subordinates in [[M19|the nineteenth movie]]. Tōjō is currently affiliated with Axl-One.
